description: This Java source file defines the OfficeData class, an immutable data holder used in the Apache Fineract project to represent office information within the organizational structure. It includes fields such as id, name, externalId, openingDate, hierarchy, and parent office details, along with static factory methods for different use cases such as import, testing, dropdowns, and templates. It implements Serializable and uses Lombok's @Getter annotation for getters.

classes.name: OfficeData
classes.description: Immutable data object for office data representing organizational offices with various attributes and factory methods.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a new OfficeData instance for importing offices, given name, parentId, openingDate, and externalId.

methods.name: setImportFields
methods.description: Sets additional import-specific fields: rowIndex, locale, and dateFormat.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates a test OfficeData instance with specified id and name.

methods.name: dropdown
methods.description: Creates a dropdown OfficeData with id, name, and decorated name.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template OfficeData with a list of parent lookups and a default opening date.

methods.name: appendedTemplate
methods.description: Creates an OfficeData based on an existing office, with allowed parents collection.

methods.name: OfficeData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields, representing an immutable snapshot of office data.

methods.name: hasIdentifyOf
methods.description: Checks whether this OfficeData instance has the specified office ID.
